cohort: Births that occurred in Lombardy, Italy during two COVID-19 lockdown periods (March 16-June 2, 2020 and November 3, 2020-April 5, 2021) and corresponding pre-pandemic periods
finding: The study found a lower proportion of low birth weight and a trend towards a lower proportion of preterm births during both lockdown periods compared to the corresponding pre-pandemic periods, while no differences were observed in stillbirth rates.
mod_finding: Induction of labor was more frequent during both lockdown periods, while cesarean section was less frequent only during the second lockdown.
